requirements.title: Online Application Submission
requirements.description: The system shall allow the applicant to submit the scholarship application online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant has valid documents, when they access the scholarship portal, then they shall be able to submit a fresh application.

Given the applicant lacks internet access, when they visit a CSC, then the CSC operator shall be permitted to apply on behalf of the student, and the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.
Given the applicant has submitted the application, when the submission is complete, then a unique application number shall be generated and communicated to the applicant.

requirements.title: Aadhaar-Based e-KYC Verification
requirements.description: The system shall perform Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant as mandatory.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant has submitted the application, when the system initiates the process, then the applicant shall be required to complete the Aadhaar-based e-KYC.
Given the applicant completes the Aadhaar-based e-KYC, when the verification is successful, then the application shall proceed to the next stage of processing.

requirements.title: Document Upload for Caste and Income Certificates
requirements.description: The system shall facilitate the submission of caste and income certificates, preferring DigiLocker integration where available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant has a caste certificate in DigiLocker, when they upload the application, then the system shall fetch the certificate from DigiLocker.
Given the applicant does not have a certificate in DigiLocker, when they upload the application, then the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
Given the applicant has submitted the documents, when the institution nodal officer verifies the application, then the system shall allow the verification of these certificates.

requirements.title: Institution Verification
requirements.description: The system shall allow the nodal officer of the institution to verify the application within the stipulated timeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant has submitted the application, when the institution nodal officer receives the notification, then they shall verify the application within 15 days of submission.
Given the application is incomplete, when the institution nodal officer identifies the deficiencies, then the system shall return the application for correction, and the applicant shall be notified.
Given the applicant resubmits the corrected application, when the institution nodal officer receives it, then they shall verify it within 15 days of receipt.

requirements.title: District Social Welfare Officer Sanction or Rejection
requirements.description: The system shall allow the District Social Welfare Officer to sanction or reject the verified application within the stipulated timeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the institution has verified the application, when the District Social Welfare Officer receives it, then they shall sanction or reject the application within 15 days of receipt.

Given the District Social Welfare Officer rejects the application, when the rejection is recorded, then the system shall require reasons to be recorded in writing, and the applicant shall be communicated the reasons.

requirements.title: Payment Processing via PFMS
requirements.description: The system shall process the scholarship payment through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is sanctioned, when the system processes the payment, then it shall push the payment to PFMS.
Given the payment is processed, when the payment is credited, then the system shall confirm the credit.

Given the bank account is not Aadhaar-seeded or is closed, when a DBT payment fails in PFMS, then the system shall notify the student by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days and re-initiate in the next weekly batch.

requirements.title: Grievance Redressal
requirements.description: The system shall provide an online grievance facility to applicants for resolving issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant has a grievance, when they submit it through the online facility, then the grievance shall be logged in the system.
Given the grievance is received, when the system processes it, then the grievance shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.

requirements.title: Status Communication via SMS
requirements.description: The system shall inform the applicant by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is submitted, when the system processes it, then the applicant shall be informed by SMS of the submission.
Given the application is verified by the institution, when the system processes it, then the applicant shall be informed by SMS of the verification status.
Given the application is sanctioned or rejected, when the system processes it, then the applicant shall be informed by SMS of the final status.

requirements.title: Renewal Application Processing
requirements.description: The system shall support the processing of renewal applications, reusing documents already verified in the previous year.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the renewal window is open, when the applicant accesses the portal, then last year's beneficiaries shall receive a prefilled renewal application.

Given the applicant has submitted the renewal application, when the institution nodal officer verifies it, then the documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and shall not be uploaded again.
Given the renewal application is submitted, when the District Social Welfare Officer receives it, then they shall sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt.

requirements.title: Eligibility Validation
requirements.description: The system shall validate the eligibility of the applicant based on the specified rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, when the system validates the eligibility, then the applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.

Given the applicant submits the application, when the system validates the eligibility, then the applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.

Given the applicant submits the application for renewal, when the system validates the eligibility, then the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.

requirements.title: Dashboard for District Social Welfare Officer
requirements.description: The system shall provide a dashboard to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the District Social Welfare Officer logs in, when they access the dashboard, then they shall see the district-wise status of applications.
Given the dashboard is displayed, when the District Social Welfare Officer views it, then they shall see the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.

requirements.title: Mobile Application Availability
requirements.description: The system shall provide a mobile application for students.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant accesses the service, when they use the mobile application, then the portal shall be available on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.

requirements.title: Rejection Correction and Re-application
requirements.description: The system shall allow a rejected applicant to correct the deficiencies and re-apply once.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant's application is rejected, when they receive the rejection reason by SMS, then they shall be given one chance to correct it and apply again.
Given the applicant re-applies, when the system processes the new application, then it shall be treated as a fresh application.

requirements.title: Appeal Process for Rejection
requirements.description: The system shall allow an applicant to appeal against rejection by the District Social Welfare Officer.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant's application is rejected, when they wish to appeal, then they shall be allowed to appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days.
Given the applicant files an appeal, when the system processes it, then the Director, Social Welfare shall allow the appeal or dismiss it within 15 days of receipt.

requirements.title: Data Retention and Audit Trail
requirements.description: The system shall retain applicant data for the specified period and maintain an audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the last payment is made, when 8 years have passed, then the applicant data shall be anonymised.
Given any status change, data edit, or export occurs, when it is performed, then the action shall be logged, and the audit trail shall be viewable by the State administrator.

requirements.title: Monthly Reporting
requirements.description: The system shall generate a monthly report for submission to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the end of the month, when the system generates the report, then a monthly report shall be submitted to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.

requirements.title: Service Timeline Compliance
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the scholarship is sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits a complete application, when the system processes it, then the scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days of submission.

requirements.title: Eligibility Income Limit
requirements.description: The system shall enforce the annual family income limit for eligibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, when the system validates the eligibility, then the applicant's annual family income shall not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.

blocks.SOURCES:
[GO-1] (Info) The State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is presently administered through paper applications submitted at institutions and forwarded to District Social Welfare Offices. Applications take 6 to 9 months to be sanctioned, files are lost in transit, and students have no means of knowing the status of their application.
[GO-2] (Info) Government has decided that all applications under the scheme, fresh and renewal, shall be received, verified, sanctioned and paid online from the academic year 2026-27, so that eligible students receive the scholarship in a transparent and time-bound manner.
[GO-3.1] (Rule) The applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.3] (Rule) The applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.4] (Rule) For renewal, the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.
[GO-4.1] (Mandate) Applications shall be submitted online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
[GO-4.2] (Mandate) Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant shall be mandatory.
[GO-4.3] (Mandate) Caste and income certificates shall be obtained from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
[GO-5.1] (Timeline) The nodal officer of the institution shall verify the application within 15 days of submission.
[GO-5.2] (Timeline) The District Social Welfare Officer shall sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt.
[GO-5.3] (Mandate) Reasons shall be recorded in writing for every rejection and communicated to the applicant.
[GO-6.1] (Mandate) The scholarship shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
[GO-6.2] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be paid in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
[GO-7.1] (Mandate) An online grievance facility shall be provided to applicants.
[GO-7.2] (Mandate) The applicant shall be informed by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
[GO-7.3] (Timeline) Grievances shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.
[GO-8.1] (Mandate) A dashboard shall be provided to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
[GO-8.2] (Mandate) A monthly report shall be submitted to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
[GO-9] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application, and the service is notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act.
[GO-10] (Mandate) Personal data collected under the scheme shall be used only for the purposes of the scheme.
[COR1-1] (Rule) In paragraph 3.2 of the G.O. read above, for "Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only)" read "Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees three lakh only)". The annual family income limit for eligibility is accordingly Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.
[COR1-2] (Info) All other conditions of the G.O. remain unchanged.
[MIN-1] (Mandate) CSC operators shall be permitted to apply on behalf of students who do not have internet access, and the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.
[MIN-2] (Mandate) For renewal applications, documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and shall not be uploaded again.
[MIN-3] (Mandate) The portal shall be available in Hindi and English.
[MIN-5] (Mandate) The portal shall work on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.
[VB-1] (Mandate) There should also be a mobile application for students, because most students have only a mobile phone.
[VB-2] (Mandate) The District Social Welfare Officer needs a dashboard showing the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
[VB-3] (Mandate) If an application is rejected, the student should be told the reason for rejection by SMS and be given one chance to correct it and apply again.

blocks.SUPERSEDED:
[GO-3.2] superseded by COR1-1: The annual income of the applicant's family from all sources shall not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only).
[MIN-4] superseded by GO-5.1: Institution verification shall be completed within 10 days of submission.
blocks.RESOLUTIONS:
[RES-1] Supersession GO-3.2, COR1-1: COR1-1 prevails.
[RES-2] Conflict GO-5.1, MIN-4: GO-5.1 prevails.
[RES-3] MissingReference GO-4.3: deferred to the department (open issue).
blocks.ANSWERS:
[ANS-1] When a DBT payment fails in PFMS (for example the account is not Aadhaar-seeded or is closed), what should happen to the application? Answer: Notify the student by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days; re-initiate in the next weekly batch
[ANS-2] Can a student appeal against rejection by the District Social Welfare Officer, and to whom? Answer: Appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days
blocks.ASSUMPTIONS:
[ASM-3] Legacy data migration: Only 2025-26 beneficiaries are migrated as a beneficiary master for renewal; pending paper applications are not migrated.
[ASM-4] Escalation on SLA breach: Institution delays are escalated to the District Social Welfare Officer, and DSWO delays to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
[ASM-5] Renewal: The renewal window opens on 1 July and last year's beneficiaries receive a prefilled renewal application.
[ASM-6] Data retention: Applicant data is retained for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymised.
[ASM-7] Audit: All status changes, data edits and exports are logged, and the audit trail is viewable by the State administrator.
